CustomField.description: QualifiedApiName of the Form Component this section renders for Field Set, Repeater, and Table types. Passed to c-flow-form, c-flow-form-repeat, or c-flow-data-table as form-qualified-api-name. The page section editor mirrors this from the FormConfigJSON wrapper's component selection (never nulled) so downstream readers stay populated; for Display Text and Lightning Web Component types it is ignored.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Form (field set, repeater, or table component built in Form Builder) that this section displays. Set it by choosing a Form in the Component tab's source selector; leave the type as Field Set, Repeater, or Table for it to apply.
CustomField.label: FormQualifiedApiName
